Name: Infinite Romance Expansion
Author: Changbaibai
Description:
[size=4][font=Arial][b]简介[/b][/font][/size]

无限配偶剧情拓展让你的婚后生活真正活过来。接入AI后， 无限为你和配偶生成独一无二的婚后拓展事件包，涵盖事件、任务、信件和对话等形式。事件包内容将根据配偶人设、玩家行为、季节天气等信息即时生成。

[size=4][b]功能介绍[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]AI生成：[/b]接入AI后，特定天数（可设置）后会生成完整的事件包，包含事件、任务、信件和对话等形式。配偶会约你出门、送你惊喜、对玩家行为做出反应。[/*]
[*][b]游戏行为抓取：[/b]AI会抓取当前季节天气节日、玩家行为（晕倒、与其他NPC的互动、下矿农作烹饪、消费购物等等），实时生成事件包。不是从预写的对话池里随机抽取。每个事件包都是实时生成的，内容不会重复。[/*]
[*][b]记忆系统：[/b]事件包之间会有所关联，配偶将记住发生过的事件。[/*]
[*][b]任务系统：[/b]配偶可能会请你帮忙，触发自定义任务并给予奖励。[/*]
[*][b]风格可调：[/b]你可以在设置的预设中选择生成风格，也可以自行调整提示词，以更好的生成想要的内容。[/*]
[*]支持自定义配偶：每位可婚NPC都在mod中设定了性格无需调整，AI会按照角色特点写出贴合人设的内容。 自定义配偶可使用，需在提示词中加入人物设定以防过度OOC。[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]安装方法[/size][/b]

[center][size=4][i][size=2][u]如果安装了GMCM（通用Mod配置菜单），所有设置都可以在游戏内直接修改，无需编辑文件[/u][/size][/i][/size][/center]

 
1. 确保已安装SMAPI
2. 下载本mod，解压到"Stardew Valley/Mods/" 目录下
3. 启动一次游戏，让mod自动生成配置文件
4. 用任意文本编辑器打开"Stardew Valley/Mods/InfiniteRomanceExpansion/config.json"
5. 填写你的API信息：
     "ApiEndpoint": "https://api.deepseek.com/v1/chat/completions ",（你的Api地址，此处以deepseek为例）
     "ApiKey": "你的API密钥",
     "ModelName": "deepseek-v4-flash", （你使用的模型名称）
6. 保存文件，启动游戏即可。

[b][size=4]兼容性[/size][/b]
为遵守部分模组作者禁止在其作品中使用AI 要求，本模组在运行时会检测AI排除列表。若安装有其中任一模组，本模组将自动禁用对所有自定义模组内容的AI交互，仅作用于原版配偶及原版游戏内容。
列表见[i][u] [url=https://stardewmodding.wiki.gg/wiki/AI_Mod_Exclusion]AI 模组排除 - 星露谷物语模组维基[/url][/u][/i]

[size=4][b]常见问题[/b][/size]

Q：每天游戏内花费多少钱？
A：以deepseek-v4-flash模型为例，随机测试默认设置下十个事件包消耗0.06人民币。

Q：兼容多配偶吗？
A：不兼容。

Q：支持多人游戏吗？
A：仅支持单人模式。

Q：为什么有时候生成的内容很奇怪？
A：内容均为AI生成后注入，请根据需求自行修改提示词以限制生成内容。

Q：出现报错[无限配偶剧情拓展]解析AI响应失败is an invalid start of a value.             
A：AI输出格式有误，请稍后重试。若反复失败，在提示词增加：只返回纯净的JSON数据，不要使用Markdown代码块标记（如```json）

[b][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]Introduction [/font][/size][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS] [/font][/size][/b]
Infinite Spouse Expansion brings your post-marriage life to life. With AI integration, it continuously generates unique post-marriage expansion event packs for you and your spouse, covering events, tasks, letters, and dialogues. The content of each event pack is generated in real time based on the spouse's personality, player behavior, season, weather, and more.
[size=4] 
[font=Comic Sans MS][b]Features[/b]  [/font][/size]
- AI Generation: After AI is connected, a full event pack—including events, tasks, letters, and dialogues—will be generated at set intervals (configurable). Your spouse may invite you out, surprise you, or react to your actions.  
- Gameplay Tracking: The AI tracks current season, weather, festivals, and player actions (e.g., passing out, interactions with other NPCs, mining, farming, cooking, shopping, etc.) to generate event packs on the fly. They are not randomly pulled from a pre-written dialogue pool. Each event pack is generated in real time and is never repeated.  
- Memory System: Event packs are interconnected, and your spouse will remember past events.  
- Quest System: Your spouse may ask for your help, triggering custom quests and rewarding you accordingly.  
- Adjustable Style: You can select a generation style from the preset options in the settings, or customize the prompt yourself to better shape the generated content.  
- Custom Spouse Support: Each marriageable NPC already has a preset personality in the mod, so no adjustments are needed—the AI will write content that fits the character. Custom spouses can also be used, but you will need to add character details in the prompt to prevent excessive OOC (out-of-character) behavior.
[font=Comic Sans MS][b][size=5] [/size]
[size=4]Installation [/size][size=5] [/size][/b][/font]
If GMCM (Generic Mod Config Menu) is installed, all settings can be adjusted directly in-game without editing any files.
 
1. Make sure SMAPI is installed.  
2. Download this mod and extract it into the `Stardew Valley/Mods/` folder.  
3. Launch the game once to let the mod generate its configuration file automatically.  
4. Open `Stardew Valley/Mods/InfiniteRomanceExpansion/config.json` with any text editor.  
5. Fill in your API information:  
   - `"ApiEndpoint": "https://api.deepseek.com/v1/chat/completions "` (your API endpoint; DeepSeek is used here as an example)  
   - `"ApiKey": "your API key"`  
   - `"ModelName": "deepseek-v4-flash"` (the model name you are using)  
6. Save the file and launch the game.

[b][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]Compatibility[/font][/size][/b]
This mod respects the AI exclusion list. If you have any mods from that list installed, AI interactions will be limited to vanilla spouses and vanilla game content only — custom mod content will be excluded automatically.  [url=https://stardewmodding.wiki.gg/wiki/AI_Mod_Exclusion]AI Mod Exclusion - Stardew Modding Wiki[/url]
 
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]FAQ  [/font][/size]
- Q: How much does it cost per in-game day?  
  A: Taking the deepseek-v4-flash model as an example, random tests under default settings show that ten event packs cost about ¥0.06 RMB.  
 
- Q: Is polygamy supported?  
  A: No.  
 
- Q: Is multiplayer supported?  
  A: Only single-player mode is supported.  
 
- Q: Why does the generated content sometimes feel strange?  
  A: All content is AI-generated and injected. Please adjust the prompt as needed to constrain the output according to your preferences.
